display_title: He Will Kiss You for 8,470 Won

titles_en.title: He Will Kiss You for 8,470 Won

description:
Min Soo-yeong is an innocent and dreamy young woman who falls in love with Choi Go-bong, a handsome and mysterious boy who offers kisses for 8470 won. She doesn't understand why he charges this specific amount, but she decides to pay to experience her first kiss. 

However, Soo-yeong discovers that he is not a simple kiss seller, but rather the heir to a powerful company who is involved in a dangerous game of power and intrigue. She finds herself involved in a romance full of obstacles and secrets, but also sweetness, passion and fun. 

Will Soo-yeong be able to win Choi Go-bong's heart and discover the meaning of his kisses?
